'''2007 Oklahoma State Championship Shannon Lackey DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Shannon Lackey]] at [[2007 Oklahoma State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
